about: The short state of the work between the orchestrator and the GPU worker. Read it first after any restart; docs/PIPELINE.md says how the two work. Only the orchestrator edits it. A goal is open until the worker has confirmed the outcome on real hardware, then closed, or with_owner when three rounds did not settle it.

goals.name: The memory step
goals.decides: Which line Setup shows for a graphics card smaller than the model, and for which cards

goals.name: Knowing the step is done
goals.decides: Which field of the app's model list shows the saved options, so Setup can put the step away

goals.name: The download readout
goals.decides: Whether Setup's size, speed and time left match the app's own window

goals.name: What a local model keeps
goals.decides: How many pieces it keeps faithfully, and what Setup and the README should promise

goals.name: The larger model
goals.decides: Whether Flux-2-Klein-9B-GGUF is worth suggesting, and for which cards

in_flight.with: the worker on the owner's computer

seen_not_yet_reported: In the worker's chat, 2026-11-26: with both memory options a one-piece outfit failed three times out of four while two to four pieces worked; with --diffusion-fa alone one, three and four pieces all worked; with neither, three pieces failed.
In the worker's chat, 2026-11-26: the page's download readout and the app's window agreed once units were accounted for (the page counts in GB, the app's window in GiB).
